headline: The forge never idles: flagship polish stages join the queue rules
lede: When the game queue and QA borrow both run dry, the builder now picks a flagship polish stage instead of stopping: the oldest unclaimed honest-gap of SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD or Myst, filed as its own issue and built the normal way. STOP is only legal when every flagship gap is owned by QA.

notes.text: #841 shipped (PR #864): claim order is now queue → QA borrow → flagship polish stage → stop-only-when-all-owned, with a pure picker (scripts/lib/idle.mjs) that reads the READMEs honestly.

jonqcheck grew idle-order coverage: flagship order, owned-gap skips, QA-held games never touched, wiring tripwires on the playbook and the architecture map — 89/89, and deleting one load-bearing line reddens it.

Next idle run points at SSX honest-gaps #1 (CPU riders missing lines) — that bullet cites shipped slices, so the next stage verifies live behavior before building; stale gap lines get pruned, not trusted.
